headline: After a wild Wednesday, the US made its new tariff plan official, inflation ran hotter than expected and markets now price a Fed rate hike on 9 December, as crypto heads into the Thanksgiving holiday.

market.asOf: Prices from TradingView's crypto price page, read about 03:54 UTC Thu 26 Nov (10:54 Bangkok). Use the live prices on this page.
market.fearGreed: Extreme fear: 9 on CoinMarketCap's Fear and Greed Index and 13 on Alternative.me's index, both read about 03:54 UTC.

stories.title: The US makes its new tariff plan official on a day of hot inflation; bitcoin's Wednesday round trip ends back near $60,000
stories.summary: Washington formally proposed extra tariffs on 14 economies and a key inflation gauge came in above forecasts. Tech stocks plunged at the open and then recovered most of the loss, and bitcoin, which has been moving with tech stocks, followed the same path.
points: The US Trade Representative found that 14 economies' "structural excess capacity" practices can be acted on under Section 301 and proposed extra tariffs on each. These are proposals: comments are due 5 January and hearings start 25 January, per USTR.
October core PCE inflation rose 3.3% from a year earlier against 3.2% expected, while headline PCE was 3.8%, in line with forecasts, per KuCoin News and TradingKey.
Final closes on Wed 25 Nov: Dow 50,182.95 (+0.33%), S&P 500 7,182.78 (-0.25%), Nasdaq 23,585.80 (-0.62%), per TradingKey, after the Nasdaq was down more than 4% in the morning, per CoinDesk.
CoinDesk reported bitcoin at about $57,500 after the open and back above $60,000 by 2:24pm ET.
US stock markets are closed today for Thanksgiving; crypto keeps trading around the clock.

stories.title: Money keeps leaving US bitcoin funds, with November outflows approaching $5 billion
stories.summary: US spot bitcoin funds have now had money flow out for days in a row, and the crypto market's total value is at its lowest in more than two years.
points: US spot bitcoin funds lost a net $231.56 million on Tuesday 24 Nov, their sixth outflow day in a row, led by BlackRock's IBIT at -$175.30 million, per Bloomingbit.
November outflows are approaching $5 billion, per The Block.
An early, incomplete count for Wednesday 25 Nov showed another $123.3 million of net outflows, per a Bitget daily report carried by ChainCatcher.
The whole crypto market was worth $2.08 trillion on Wednesday, its lowest since September 2024, per The Block.

sources.label: Bloomingbit: spot bitcoin ETF flows, 24 Nov

stories.title: Washington pulls both ways: a bitcoin reserve bill reaches the House floor while Democratic senators push the SEC to scrap its crypto rules
stories.summary: A bill to write a US Strategic Bitcoin Reserve into law is now eligible for a vote of the full House. On the same day, Democratic senators led by Elizabeth Warren and Chris Van Hollen asked the SEC to withdraw two pro-crypto measures.
points: H.R. 8957, the American Reserve Modernization Act from Rep. Nick Begich, was sent to the full House on 24 Nov after the House Financial Services Committee approved it 28-21, per The Block.
The bill would bar any sale of reserve bitcoin for at least 20 years and require proof-of-reserve reporting, per The Block.
Sens. Warren, Van Hollen, Tina Smith and Jack Reed want the SEC to withdraw its proposed "Regulation Crypto Assets" and its "innovation exemption" for tokenized-securities venues, per The Block.
The SEC proposal includes a startup exemption for offerings up to $5 million and a fundraising exemption up to $75 million, per The Block.

briefs.title: Fidelity files for a spot Chainlink fund
briefs.summary: Fidelity filed to list a spot Chainlink (LINK) fund on Nasdaq under the ticker FLNK; it will not stake its LINK, per Yahoo Finance.

briefs.title: Fidelity adds AAVE, LINK and UNI for US retail customers
briefs.summary: Fidelity's US retail crypto platform added Aave, Chainlink and Uniswap on 24 Nov, taking it to 8 assets, per U.Today.

briefs.title: Bit Digital sold ether to cut its Galaxy loan
briefs.summary: Bit Digital sold 29,825 ETH between 15 and 23 Nov to repay $50 million of its loan from Galaxy, per The Block.

briefs.title: US moves to keep $1.1 billion of USDC from North Korea's Binance hack
briefs.summary: The Justice Department filed to permanently forfeit more than $1.1 billion in USDC tied to North Korea's $6.4 billion hack of Binance, per Decrypt.

briefs.title: Bank of Korea raises rates
briefs.summary: South Korea's central bank raised its key rate by a quarter point to 3.25% on Thursday, per The Korea Herald.

briefs.title: Oil jumps after a claimed attack on a Saudi refinery
briefs.summary: Brent crude settled at $94.61 after Yemen's Houthis claimed an attack on Saudi Arabia's Ras Tanura refinery, adding to inflation worries, per ChainCatcher's daily wrap.

briefs.title: Franklin Templeton's crypto index fund adds HYPE
briefs.summary: The Franklin Crypto Index ETF (EZPZ) will add Hyperliquid's HYPE from 1 December, per an SEC filing reported by The Block.

calendar.event: ISM manufacturing PMI (Nov), job openings (JOLTS, Oct); Fed Vice Chair Bowman testifies
calendar.note: ISM: consensus 55, October 55.5. JOLTS: consensus 7.3 million, September 7.52 million (consensus per Nowflation; prior per ISM and AP). Bowman appears before the House Financial Services Committee.
October was +86,000, per Nowflation. No published consensus found.
October was 54.5, per InvestingLive. Weekly jobless claims come out the same day at 8:30am ET.
Consensus +82,000 jobs and 4.2% unemployment, per Nowflation. October payrolls rose 165,000 with unemployment at 4.1%, per ABC7/AP.

Markets expect a rate hike, not a cut. CME FedWatch put the chance of a quarter-point hike at 97.8% on the morning of 25 Nov, per MarketSpeaker, and 94.4% after the PCE inflation data, per KuCoin News. The current target range is 3.75-4.00%.
